decisionRationale: The 2018 U.S. Viking hardcover is the earliest located English edition with stable bibliographic support and a full public chapter list.
The official Penguin Random House product page shows the 2018 hardcover and 2019 paperback as the same 624-page U.S. work family.
The library catalog and Ingram table of contents agree on the same 19-entry chapter order.
The concise edition is materially shorter and therefore excluded from the chapter contract.
No translation or edition ambiguity was found that would materially change chapter count, order, or chapter-level interpretation.
